item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, there will be fog over the coast of Guangdong early next week and it will be rather warm during the day. A cold front is expected to reach southern China on Tuesday night, the weather will become cool over the region. Showers will affect the region in the following couple of days.

Date/Month: 19/03 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Foggy in the morning. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 21 - 27 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
